I'm a PhD student in ecology at the University of Oxford. My research looks at
the ecological credibility and long-term durability of biodiversity and
nature-based carbon offsets.

This site is where I write up analyses from my project repositories, post
shorter notes, and host a few interactive tools.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" icon=false}
**Featured walkthrough:** [Permanence risks in biodiversity &
nature-based carbon offsets](walkthroughs/offset-permanence/index.qmd) —
a structured review with an interactive database of major schemes.
:::
